prompts.tree:
Create one production-ready transparent PNG sprite for a 6x6 museum mystery puzzle board.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: reusable top-down game object sprite.
Object: exactly one cultivated indoor potted olive tree / small ficus tree. It must clearly read as a TREE rather than a round shrub when displayed at 64-96 px. Show a small warm terracotta planter at the base, one visible warm-brown main trunk splitting into two or three branches, and an airy irregular canopy with clear gaps between clusters of fresh sage, medium-green and light-green leaves. The canopy should be taller and less circular than a hedge.
Camera: elevated orthographic top-down game view around 70 degrees from above so the pot and trunk remain visible, centered, full object visible, generous margin. Not front eye-level and not a pure circular overhead blob.
Style: clean hand-painted game illustration, restrained detail, slightly dimensional, cohesive elegant museum mystery art direction.
Lighting: bright soft neutral studio daylight, lifted shadows, upper-mid values, no crushed blacks, no noir lighting, no heavy ambient occlusion, no vignette.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA.
Constraints: no floor, no grass patch, no square backdrop, no border, no text, no label, no people, no extra props, no clipped leaves. A subtle compact contact shadow may remain within the sprite only.
